column1: # Every unit test added because of a FIX, in either compiler -- one row per test, added in the SAME
# commit as the test itself. `reference_test_census.sh --fixes` prints the bootstrap rows still owed.

#     <fix>         the fix, in a few words
#     <file>        the test's file, relative to its repository's root
#     <test>        the case name as the source spells it (a template where it is one); a test here
